testName: Special Requirements Test #1 20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: When turning right onto a narrow street in a long vehicle, you may need to:
questions.explanation: When turning right onto a narrow street in a long vehicle, approach the corner normally. During the turn, swing left just enough so your right rear wheels clear the curb. Do not swing so far left that another driver tries to pass you on the right.

questions.question: A vehicle's load limit depends on:

options.text: The speed limits on your route.
The weather conditions on your route.
The number of axles on the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The number of axles on the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Load limits vary by vehicle. Each vehicle's limit depends on its size, number of axles, distance between axles, and tire size.

questions.question: Mud flaps must be within ____ of the road surface.
questions.explanation: Mud flaps must be within eight inches of the road surface when required. They are required on vehicles with four or more tires on the rear axle.

questions.question: When towing a vehicle with a chain, rope, or cable, a ____ flag must also be attached.
questions.explanation: A white flag at least 12 square inches must be attached to the towing connector. The chain, rope, or cable should not be longer than 15 feet.

questions.question: When turning right in a long vehicle, you should stay about ____ away from the curb as you approach the corner.
questions.explanation: When turning right in a long vehicle like a tractor-trailer or bus, stay about four feet from the curb. This helps ensure your rear wheels clear the curb. Turn wide to the right as soon as your front wheels pass the corner.

questions.question: If you make an emergency stop on the roadside and cannot see clearly ahead, place a warning signal between ____ behind your vehicle.
questions.explanation: All commercial drivers must carry emergency equipment. If you make an emergency stop where your vision is blocked, place a warning signal between 100 and 500 feet behind your vehicle.

questions.question: A vehicle used only to transport pipes or poles:

options.text: Can never exceed the legal limit for loads extending over the front or rear.
Must exceed the legal limit for loads extending over the front or rear.
May exceed the legal limit for loads extending over the front or rear, if needed.
Should always be shorter than the maximum vehicle length limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: May exceed the legal limit for loads extending over the front or rear, if needed.
questions.explanation: A vehicle used only for pipes or poles may exceed the legal limit for loads extending over the front or rear if needed. Mark any load extending past the rear with a red flag.

questions.question: If you make an emergency stop on the roadside and cannot see clearly ahead, place the first warning signal ____ behind your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Place the first warning signal 10 feet behind your vehicle during an emergency stop. If your view is blocked, also place a signal 100 feet in front and another between 100 and 500 feet behind your vehicle.

questions.question: Farm tractors and other vehicles with wheels that have cleats, lugs, or spikes cannot operate:
questions.explanation: Farm tractors cannot operate on highways if they have wheels with cleats, lugs, flanges, studs, or spikes. These extensions can damage the road.

questions.question: In Texas, a vehicle combination can have no more than:
questions.explanation: In Texas, combinations can have three or fewer vehicles. Check each state's rules when traveling on the interstate.

questions.question: You should drive below the speed limit when:

options.text: Driving on a highway with other cars.
Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: It is unsafe to drive too fast for the conditions, even if the speed limit is higher. Whenever conditions are not perfect, slow down and increase your following distance.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Keep as much space as possible between your vehicle and others.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep as much space as possible between your vehicle and others.
questions.explanation: When passing, keep as much space as possible between your vehicle and others. Your vehicle creates wind that can be dangerous to smaller vehicles nearby.

questions.question: The maximum total width of a vehicle with a load is:
questions.explanation: A vehicle carrying a load may not be wider than 102 inches. There are some exceptions to this rule.

questions.question: A school bus driver should do what when approaching a railroad crossing:
questions.explanation: School buses with passengers must stop before crossing railroad tracks. Check both directions for trains before continuing. However, if a police officer tells you to cross without stopping, follow their direction.

questions.question: If a semitrailer is parked on a roadway shoulder where vision is blocked, and flags are used instead of lights, flags should be placed:

options.text: In front of and behind the vehicle.
Only in front of the vehicle.
On the front and rear of the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: In front of and behind the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Place flags both in front of and behind the vehicle. Put the front flag 100 feet away. Put the rear flag 100 to 500 feet away.

questions.question: Tailgating is allowed:

options.text: If the vehicle in front is driving below the speed limit.
If the vehicle in front has a slow-moving emblem.

questions.explanation: Tailgating is dangerous and frustrates other drivers. Keep a safe following distance of at least four seconds in good conditions, or six to eight seconds in poor conditions.

questions.question: If driving at night with a load extending more than four feet past the rear, attach ____ to the end of the load.
questions.explanation: At night, attach a burning red light to the end of loads extending more than four feet beyond the vehicle. The light must be visible from at least 500 feet away.

questions.question: During the day, if a load extends more than four feet past the rear, you should:

options.text: Attach two white reflectors to the load sides.
Attach a red flag to the end of the load.
Attach a red lamp to the load side.
Attach a yellow flag to the end of the load.

questions.correctAnswerText: Attach a red flag to the end of the load.
questions.explanation: Attach a red flag to the end of loads extending more than four feet beyond the vehicle. The flag must be at least 12 square inches.

questions.question: A vehicle transporting cotton seeds may not exceed ____ in length.
questions.explanation: Vehicles carrying cotton seeds, cotton, or cotton processing equipment may not be longer than 48 feet.

questions.question: A bus wider than 80 inches must have two ____ clearance lamps on the top rear corners.
questions.explanation: Buses wider than 80 inches need two red lamps on the top rear corners. Two amber lamps are required on the top front corners.
